_meta.subject: Get24 v0.0.9
_meta.purpose: Flat, UI/backend-consumable risk report. Each row is one finding. Risk levels: HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW / NEGLIGIBLE.

runtime_summary.reason_cannot_boot: Express 3 app.configure() + Socket.IO 0.9 io.configure()/io.set() both removed in their respective v4 / v1 upgrades

risk_items.title: Node.js engine declared as 0.8.x; functional only on 6.17.1
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Target Node 20 LTS via Express 4 + Socket.IO 4 upgrades
risk_items.regression_risk: Every async behavior, timer precision, and Buffer API assumption may differ across 12 years of Node.js evolution

risk_items.title: app.configure() removed in Express 4 — server will not boot
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Remove configure() wrappers; inline middleware directly. Add serve-favicon, morgan, errorhandler packages.
risk_items.regression_risk: Middleware ordering must be exactly preserved. boot-level failure means all 18 tests fail if order is wrong.

risk_items.title: io.configure() / io.set() removed in Socket.IO 1.x — server will not boot on Socket.IO 4
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Replace with cors option on Socket.IO constructor
risk_items.blast_radius: server/index.js Socket.IO config block; test harness uses socket.io-client internals that change in v3+
risk_items.regression_risk: Highest-risk single change. Test harness (harness.js, socket.test.js, game-events.test.js) must be updated in the same step. socket.socket.connected path changes in Socket.IO 3+.

risk_items.title: Production CORS origin hardcoded to defunct Nodejitsu PaaS (http://get24.jit.su:80)
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Replace with ORIGIN environment variable passed to Socket.IO cors option
risk_items.blast_radius: server/index.js line 55 — production deploy only; tests bypass via xhr-shim
risk_items.regression_risk: Low for existing tests (bypassed by harness); high for any real deployment

risk_items.title: socket.io@0.9.x end-of-life
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Upgrade to socket.io@4.x; update socket.io-client in test harness to match
risk_items.blast_radius: server/index.js config block; SocketController.js client-side io.connect('/') API deprecated
risk_items.regression_risk: io.connect is deprecated in favor of io(). Client harness Transport.websocket trick may not apply to 4.x client internals.

risk_items.title: express@3.0.x end-of-life
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Upgrade to express@4.x
risk_items.regression_risk: app.configure() is the only breaking surface; static file serving and routing APIs are preserved. Mechanical but total change to middleware registration.

risk_items.title: node-expression-eval@0.1.x unmaintained since 2013
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Replace with expr-eval@2.x (maintained continuation of same codebase)
risk_items.blast_radius: server/game/index.js lines 12 and 65 — core game mechanic
risk_items.regression_risk: Any difference in operator precedence, whitespace handling, or error type would change evaluated values and break the 4 game-events expression tests

risk_items.title: Server start is a module side-effect — requires child process spawn for tests
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Export a start() function; call it from index.js. Expose server and io for programmatic shutdown.
risk_items.regression_risk: Startup ordering must be preserved exactly (middleware before listen, Socket.IO after server). No observable HTTP/socket behavior changes.

risk_items.title: Global mutable gameList and numConnections — no inter-test isolation without process boundary
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Encapsulate in a GameManager class or closure passed to start()
risk_items.regression_risk: Tests currently isolated by spawning a fresh process per test. Risk only materializes if in-process testing is adopted.

risk_items.title: KineticJS 4.6.0 abandoned — superseded by Konva.js
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Replace with Konva.js; fix F-16 (layer→activeLayer) and F-17 (blink||true) in the same pass
risk_items.blast_radius: public/js/StageController.js (entire file); http.test.js filename and 'Kinetic' string assertions must be updated
risk_items.regression_risk: shadowOffset array→object syntax; some Tween/Animation property names differ. No server-side risk. No visual regression test coverage.
risk_items.safety_net_tests: http.test.js (filename and Kinetic string assertions need update)

risk_items.title: express.favicon() removed in Express 4
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Replace with serve-favicon package
risk_items.regression_risk: favicon.ico test in http.test.js must still return 200

risk_items.title: node-uuid@1.4.x deprecated
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Replace with uuid@9.0.1 (two-line change; output format identical)
risk_items.regression_risk: UUID v4 format unchanged; socket.test.js UUID_V4 regex must still pass

risk_items.title: validate() called without type guard — TypeError on non-string socket input
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Add typeof data.expression !== 'string' guard before validate() call
risk_items.regression_risk: Negligible — guard adds silent return for inputs no existing test sends

risk_items.title: setInterval not cleared on server stop — event loop stays alive
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: clearInterval on SIGINT / server close event
risk_items.regression_risk: No functional impact on behavior; affects test teardown speed

risk_items.title: socket.disconnect() should be socket.disconnect(true) in Socket.IO 4
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Change to socket.disconnect(true) when upgrading to Socket.IO 4
risk_items.regression_risk: game-events.test.js capacity test must still show rejected socket disconnected

risk_items.title: helpDialog.toggle() ReferenceError: layer is not defined
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Replace layer with activeLayer (fix alongside KineticJS→Konva upgrade)
risk_items.blast_radius: client UI only — clicking Help button crashes in browser
risk_items.regression_risk: No server test coverage; UI-only fix

risk_items.title: blink || true always forces blink regardless of argument
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Change to blink !== false (fix alongside KineticJS→Konva upgrade)
risk_items.blast_radius: client UI only — showEvaluatedText blink parameter silently ignored
risk_items.regression_risk: No server test coverage; UI-only fix

risk_items.title: express.logger() removed in Express 4
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Replace with morgan('dev') package
risk_items.regression_risk: No behavioral test asserts log output

risk_items.title: express.errorHandler() removed in Express 4
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Replace with errorhandler package
risk_items.regression_risk: No behavioral test exercises error response pages

risk_items.title: Hard-coded defunct Nodejitsu production origin
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Replace with ORIGIN environment variable (absorbed into Socket.IO 4 upgrade)
risk_items.regression_risk: No test exercises the production configure block

risk_items.title: No package-lock.json — floating version ranges
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Mitigated by npm-shrinkwrap.json in legacy/get24-baseline/repro/
risk_items.regression_risk: Negligible — baseline pinned via shrinkwrap

risk_items.title: README and server/config.json disagree on default port (3001 vs 4000)
risk_items.modernization_opportunity: Align README to config; note PORT env var wins
risk_items.regression_risk: None
